exposure: Planned caesarean section for breech presentation
cohort: Singleton children born at term in Scotland, attending Scottish schools between 2006 and 2011 (n=456,947).
finding: Vaginal breech delivery was associated with lower examination attainment and poorer Apgar scores compared to planned caesarean section for breech presentation or vaginal cephalic delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech delivery was associated with poorer Apgar scores and lower examination attainment compared to planned caesarean section for breech presentation.
